newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM unit in Polish joint venture.
newsitem.headline: DSM unit in Polish joint venture.

text.p: Dutch DSM Resins BV, unit of chemicals group DSM NV, said on Thursday it was forming a joint-venture with Polish organika-Sarzyna for the marketing and sale of polyester fibre in central Europe.
The 50-50 joint venture, to be named DSM-Sarzyna Structural Resins, will be Warsaw-based and will supply specialty resins and Organika-Sarzyna's commodity products in central Europe.
DSM Resins will contribute its know-how in the segment of polyester resins production to the jointly owned company.
DSM Resins and Organika-Sarzyna have had a distribution cooperation in Poland since 1995.
"This successful cooperation will be stepped up further by creating this joint venture," the Dutch group said.
Organika-Sarzyna posts annual turnover of about 100 million guilders. DSM Resins has annual sales of 1.5 billion guilders.
